channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: Why can content stay hidden when aria-expanded becomes true?
item.description: Keep a button’s expanded state in sync with its panel. Test opening, closing, reopening, and restoring state.

item.title: Why can break-word and anywhere yield different intrinsic widths?
item.description: Compare one token under two wrapping values and separate visible line breaks from intrinsic sizing.

item.title: Why can CTest fail a process that returns zero?
item.description: Compare CTest's inverted and ordinary normal-exit rules, then verify the identity of a negative test's rejection.

item.title: How can Docker COPY preserve parent paths from several directories?
item.description: Compare ordinary and parent-preserving Docker COPY exports with content and absence checks at the consumer's expected paths.

item.title: How can you isolate the resolution in a Git merge commit?
item.description: Compare a Git remerge view, first-parent diff, and committed file to inspect a two-parent conflict resolution.

item.title: Does an empty Scanner.Text mean EOF?
item.description: Compare blank lines, empty input, and an unterminated final line to detect early termination of a Scanner loop.

item.title: Why does Go add one month to October 31 and land on December 1?
item.description: Compare UTC timestamp oracles for AddDate normalization, an explicit month-end clamp, and a reverse calendar change.

item.title: Why do same-name details in separate sections close each other?
item.description: Use four details elements to test local exclusion and independence across sections. Check the scope of a shared name in one tree.

item.title: Why is zero not a placeholder for Content-Length after 411?
item.description: Use three fixed bytes to distinguish a missing length, zero, and a valid count, with local checks kept separate from upload completion.

item.title: Why does at(-0.5) read the first item instead of the last?

item.title: Why can Promise.resolve(load()) miss a synchronous throw?

item.title: Why can a CronJob skip a Job after a one-minute delay?
item.description: Compare a CronJob's scheduled time with its controller check to explain a missed occurrence under thirty- and ninety-second windows.

item.title: Why can micro precision be 80% while macro is below 45%?
item.description: Compute two precision averages from a fixed nine-to-one example and retain class denominators to expose the minority-class failure.

item.title: Why does bisect with a key still reject a whole search record?
item.description: Check probe types, tied-score boundaries, and inserted record identity across bisect and insort.

item.title: Why did dataclasses.asdict replace the field object too?
item.description: Use list mutations and a nested owner to compare recursive dataclass conversion with a shallow fields/getattr projection.

item.title: Why does a full deque accept append but reject insert?
item.description: Compare endpoint additions, indexed insertion, and a left-side batch on independent bounded deques.

item.title: Why does isclose still reject a tiny residual against zero?
item.description: Check signed residuals on both sides of an absolute bound, then verify isclose's special-value behavior.

item.title: How can unittest release registered resources before the test ends?

item.title: Why can SQLite integrity_check return ok with an orphan row?

item.title: Why can a service exceed MemoryHigh without being killed immediately?
item.description: Distinguish systemd reclaim pressure from the hard memory limit and inspect effective values alongside cgroup events.

item.title: Why remove aria-sort from the old header after changing columns?
item.description: Sort a table by name and count, then check the row order, active direction, and previous header after switching columns.

item.title: Which stage does Buildx select by default in this Dockerfile?
item.description: Inspect the default Buildx stage and compare it with an explicit target using two fresh local exports.

item.title: Why can a newly inserted notice appear without fading in?

item.title: Why did CTest show a skip after the test process exited nonzero?
item.description: Use three isolated process outcomes to distinguish passed, skipped, and failed CTest runs and verify required coverage.

item.title: Can Git recognize the same patch when its files arrive in a different order?
item.description: Swap complete Git file diffs and introduce an actual edit to see when stable and unstable patch IDs differ.

item.title: Did strings.Cut see an equals sign if the value was empty?
item.description: Use four configuration lines to distinguish an empty right side from a missing separator and preserve inheritance, clearing, and assignment.

item.title: Why didn't sync.Once.Do retry after a panic?
item.description: Use an attempt count, configuration state, and a fresh-instance control to separate Once behavior after a panic from retries owned by the application.

item.title: Does HTTP 300 make a client jump to one URL?

item.title: Is HTTP 408 the same as a client-side timeout?

item.title: Why can instanceof Array reject an array from another realm?

item.title: How can a regex search treat the plus in A+B literally?

item.title: Why can a Pending Pod avoid scheduling even when nodes are free?

item.title: Why can mean confidence match accuracy without calibration?

item.title: Why did the shortage disappear from Counter subtraction?

item.title: Why does EJECT return an int for an unknown flag bit?

item.title: Why did testzip() return None for a ZIP missing its manifest?
item.description: Use intact, corrupted, and missing-manifest ZIPs to compare testzip(), required names, and format identification.

item.title: Why did ZPOPMIN return one member and remove the key?
item.description: Compare a read and two pops on a disposable sorted set. Check the return count, member order, and key state after the last pop.

item.title: Why can a systemd service still run after its main process exits?

item.title: How can a quality slider describe position 2 as Standard?
item.description: Use a native three-position slider to check that the numeric position, visible preset, and aria-valuetext stay in sync.

item.title: Why did a full CMake install omit this component?

item.title: How can a fixed-width textarea grow with its content?

item.title: Why can a focused button fail to match :focus-visible?

item.title: Why did Go CopyN write bytes even though it failed?
item.description: Compare a complete Go transfer with a short source and verify what would remain in the destination.

item.title: After HTTP 413, should the client shrink the file or wait?

item.title: Why can a bilingual document carry one Content-Language tag?
item.description: Use a French quote in an English tutorial to check intended audience and local language independently in Content-Language and HTML lang.

item.title: Do running Pods wait in place when a Kubernetes Job is suspended?
item.description: Compare Job and Pod UIDs across Kubernetes suspension and resumption, and verify application progress separately.

item.title: Why can two A votes choose different answers?

item.title: Why can switching PostgreSQL regex functions remove unmatched rows?
item.description: Compare scalar captures with per-match rows and check source identity in PostgreSQL.

item.title: Why did narrowing pytest’s conftest boundary hide a fixture?

item.title: Why does introspection see a wrapper that forwards every argument?

item.title: Why can’t you zip as_completed results back to the original inputs?

item.title: Why can Redis SMOVE succeed without growing the destination?
item.description: Compare two successful moves that have different effects on destination cardinality.

item.title: Why does a missing file skip one systemd unit but fail another start?
item.description: Check the same path in two systemd units and distinguish a condition skip, an assertion failure, and actual execution.

item.title: When should aria-busy end during a two-step update?

item.title: Why did a BuildKit multi-platform export add another directory level?
item.description: Compare BuildKit local exporter layouts using a distinct marker for each target platform.

item.description: Compare copied and relative-symlink CMake installations, then check both after moving their install trees.

item.title: Can text-wrap: balance add a line to a short heading?
item.description: Compare ordinary and balanced wrapping on headings with identical text and width. Test the short-heading line-count rule in the CSS Text 4 draft.

item.title: Why is a blank required input invalid before it is user-invalid?

item.title: Why can’t Go Rows.Next returning false certify a complete result?

item.title: Is HTTP 203 a failure? Check the response’s transforming proxy
item.description: Compare an origin catalog with a 200 response and a transformed view with a 203 response. Keep the request path when interpreting or validating the delivered content.

item.title: What should you reduce after HTTP 431?
